finalText:
Build's clean now. Exit code 0, `link ok` on both retry budget and backoff.

Two real bugs hid under the noise, both from the bundler bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. That crashed the link step outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid. The old config loader used to send `false`; the new one sends `undefined`. Fixed it to treat both as disabled.

The rest really was noise, deprecation notices from the bump with no code to fix.
